evidence.limitations: This is a browser provenance gate, not proof of native client functionality or completed business workflows. Parsed modules absent from emitted chunks are explicitly not represented as browser implementation. Upstream tarball output is bound by registry integrity and exact installed-file bytes; no claim of a byte-for-byte rebuild of React or every upstream compiler.

dependencyUpdate.sourceTransform: Normalize apps/site/node_modules/@bufbuild/protobuf to node_modules/@bufbuild/protobuf; deduplicate equal module IDs/import edges. Predicted303 parsed modules become243 before compilation; all physical module bytes match prior admissions. Contracts executable JS and all66 protobuf implementation files are byte-identical to previously admitted inputs. Upstream source diff changes only package declarations and protoc-gen-es version comment.
dependencyUpdate.outputTransform: Nine chunks and every chunk import/dynamic-import edge remain. Fourteen duplicate protobuf module placements disappear from hello; reflect/error and to-binary move from cloud-hello to shared hello_pb. The rendered module set is exactly the old set after path normalization. Only cloud-hello.js, hello.js and hello_pb.js normalized templates change; all other15 templates remain identical. All115 sourcemap original-source bodies match previously admitted source hashes; no unexpected source appears. Shared-chunk exports redistribute unchanged functions. Diagnostic sourcemaps/relaxed chunk recording are local-only and were removed/restored before committing; production exact graph/template guards remain.
dependencyUpdate.validation: One compilation with a precomputed module/edge oracle; reuse its bytes for final profile checks. Hosted candidate must independently satisfy the frozen graph/templates. No browser, public download or second local compilation.
dependencyUpdate.priorEvidence: Retained sourceArchives and embedded source evidence describe prior independent inspections; unchanged byte evidence is reused, not claimed as a fresh upstream download. Current package identities/components and this producer receipt define the admitted dependency versions.

canonicalHostUpdate.decision: Web owns the authored canonical-host edge wrapper. Exact www.arcforges.com requests receive HTTPS apex HTTP 308 before static assets, preserving path/query. Other requests and asset responses pass unchanged through ASSETS. Cloud retains apex /api/* and the browser retains same-origin redirect:error.
canonicalHostUpdate.oracle: Retain the complete r5 browser module graph, all 18 normalized browser templates, package identities, legal inputs, Contracts metadata and both SBOM expectations unchanged. The private worker/index.js is independently compared with its reviewed LF-normalized source, never inferred from an output build. No browser/compiler/dependency change is admitted.
canonicalHostUpdate.validation: Existing Windows/Linux source/static/offline checks and Linux candidate construction. Targeted offline regressions cover redirect routing, original asset passthrough, configuration and independent private-script substitution rejection. No browser/live-service CI or public-asset downloads; existing local Node Request/Response navigation check only.
